canonical.source: owner attachment 'EraClash Logo Mk1.png' (Desktop, 2026-08-31 21:08), copied byte-for-byte
canonical.usageStatus: ARCHIVAL_MASTER — not served by the product; never regenerated, redrawn or vectorised here

product.source: downscale of the canonical PNG made in Phase 9A (commit 7e45454); same alpha profile, same letterforms
product.usageStatus: IN_PRODUCT — global header (master-brand shell) and the Play Lobby's obsidian brand band

background.measured: corner pixels alpha 0; 57.8% of pixels fully transparent, 16.7% partially transparent (anti-aliased edges and glow), 2.8% opaque near-black
background.verdict: TRANSPARENT background. The letterforms themselves carry opaque black fills and a dark drop-shadow, so the mark is designed for DARK surfaces: on ivory the platinum face disappears and the black fills read as stray marks.
background.rule: Render the logo only on Brand Obsidian / Night Obsidian surfaces (header, lobby brand band, dark result hero). Never on Warm Court Ivory.

colourRead.coolEdge: #9090A8 (the cobalt-tinted shade on the letterforms' left faces)
colourRead.note: The master brand's Obsidian/Platinum/Graphite tokens were read from this mark in Phase 9A.1 (masterBrandTokens.js).

policy: do not redraw letters with an approximate font
vectorisation is a separate brand-production task
no NBA, league or competitor marks anywhere in production surfaces
